notes.title: Wukong UP: Four chained, out Aug 20!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Dear players, hello everyone! The multiplayer online game [i]Wukong UP[/i], where players are chained together, is officially released today![/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you all for your continuous support. From the Demo test to the official version test, you have provided numerous excellent suggestions and bug reports for [i]Wukong UP[/i]. Of course, the official version launched this time will definitely offer a 良心 price. You can take home the entire 81 trials for just a few dozen yuan, and even go to the Heavenly Court to compete with the Tathagata![/p][p]
[/p][h2][i]Wukong UP[/i] is more than just [i]Only UP[/i].[/h2][p]
[/p][p]Skating, jump games, light puzzle-solving, and chase sequences can all be experienced in [i]Wukong UP[/i].[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900290/75e021c6294f9e65e7e290bc93aa5cda92266113.png"][/img][/p][h2]It supports up to four players in online mode, allowing you and your buddies to "day day UP UP" together![/h2][p]In [i]Wukong UP[/i], the four disciples (Master and his three disciples) are cursed by robots and forced to be chained together. Only by overcoming the 81 trials can you regain freedom![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900290/bbb23afb94fa2d0fec1692e6c32224a9c7a7a2c9.png"][/img][/p][h2]Wukong vs. Cosmic Robots[/h2][p]What to do when facing the robots that abducted you? Of course, fight back fiercely! You can use either the Golden Cudgel or the "American Iaijutsu" as you like![/p][p]Moreover, continuous kills will increase your media score, and finally, you can win the "Game of the Year"![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900290/aa7526c745944f5d21a2bbdf4064c899c4bc8fab.png"][/img][/p][h2]Multiple unique characters to choose from[/h2][p]The 72 transformations are certainly put to good use. There are cheongsam, swimsuit with twin tails, and all kinds of Wukong styles you like. [i]Wukong UP[/i] can satisfy your imagination of Wukong!
[/p][p]Once again, thank you all for your love and support for [i]Wukong UP[/i]! The game will be officially released on August 20th. Visit the Steam store page now, search for [i]Wukong UP[/i], place your order and enjoy the game![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900290/5b188fc5820729dfc9a02550da231875f80c12b7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can also participate in activities on Xunyou to win game gifts![/p]
